reasoning_traces.think:
The signal wiring lane operates as a data ingress module that directly interfaces ESPN feeds into the GSI Bayesian inference engine. It establishes a foundational layer where raw sport data is transformed into structured signals. The publish lane supersede function acts as a post-processing gate, resolving inconsistencies in NFL predictions by superseding pending entries based on updated spreads and totals. This duality mirrors a control-theoretic feedback loop: input signals are processed and validated before being committed to the publish pipeline. Failure modes include data loss during ingestion or incorrect superseding due to stale or conflicting inputs. The night-shift proof system ensures that all transitions within this process maintain logical consistency, particularly around canonical redirects and write guards. These systems interlock such that any disruption in signal flow propagates through to the publish stage, necessitating robust error handling and rollback mechanisms.
